author: Ankit
problem: tasks are (name, priority, due_day) triples. Return the task names in the order to work on them: higher priority first, and among equal priorities the one due sooner first.
bug_description: Sorts by (priority, due_day) with reverse=True, which also reverses the due days, so among equal priorities the latest-due task comes first.

comments.accurate: Task names ordered by priority, highest first, then by the soonest due day
comments.wrong_behavior: Task names ordered by priority, then by due day, both from highest to lowest
comments.wrong_location: Sort order verified; check that only the names are returned, in that order
